description: Create a plain-JavaScript starter game (miniant.json, index.html, main.js with the Miniant SDK init, ready and reportResult skeleton) in a new or empty directory, resolved against the server's working directory. Refuses a non-empty directory. For Phaser, Unity, Godot or other engines read_guide sdk/engines instead. This is the only tool that writes files. modes are mode ids (solo, vs_ai, local_multiplayer, online_friends, online_random), default [solo]; non-solo modes need extra work that validate_build will list.
name: scaffold_game
